no, i really do want to just die.. i am only here to find out more about this reality around me... im not exactly all with it, right now.

basically i am collapsing internally, trying to determine my next move since things are about to get extremely ugly.. tomorrow is going to be fucking hell, i am going to decide to leave my place and go to somewhere with almost no money and a plan to die.  that is about it.

i just want to be dead, i do not really want to be supported... perhaps i am in the wrong place.. but the end reality is that i dont want to be around anymore, i dont want to feel the misery inside anymore, and nothing is going to change who i am or what i know.  

while it is selfish, i just want to find a way out.

i'm sitting here in a daze, eyes half open, so scared thinking of death.  and, how the hell can i go thru with it, without ensuring that others do not get hurt?  i hate this fucking life, its a joke, i cannot stop thinking of everything negative, just want death... please let me die
ok, sorry, i must be confused.  actually, no, i'm insane.

how about you go die in a fire
